note: Golden conversations for the AI seller. The platform admin runs them against a shop on any model from the training room (graded by a judge model), or backend/scripts/ai_eval.py prints them for a human; the same set is the regression test when the model changes. A conversation may give displayName (the customer's chat-app name) and burst (its lines are one burst of messages). A conversation with "shop" (a shop address, e.g. beit-elshawarma or nile-style, the seeded demo shops) is played only on that shop.
